# Ansteyapps

> Ansteyapps makes two affordable, offline, at-home practice apps for people recovering after a stroke and related neurological conditions. Both are self-management and wellbeing tools — not medical devices — available in 19 languages for a one-time £29.99 purchase, with no subscription, no ads, and no data collection. A free demo of each app is available.

Ansteyapps Limited is a UK company (Companies House 17177054), founded by Liam Anstey. The apps were built to fill a gap in simple, at-home rehabilitation practice tools that people can use between clinical appointments. They complement professional care and do not diagnose, treat, or cure any condition. The guides listed below are free to read and share.

## Apps

- [Stroke Sight](https://ansteyapps.com/stroke-sight/): At-home visual-scanning and reading exercises for visual field loss and neglect after stroke — covering hemianopia, quadrantanopia, visual neglect and scotoma. Eight evidence-informed exercises, works offline, 19 languages, £29.99 one-time. iOS and Android.
- [ReWrite](https://ansteyapps.com/rewrite/): At-home handwriting and hand-dexterity practice for adults relearning to write after a stroke, also useful in aphasia and Parkinson's. Guided letter, word and sentence tracing in 19 languages, works offline, £29.99 one-time. iOS and Android.

## For clinicians

- [Clinician information](https://ansteyapps.com/clinicians/): Evidence summary and information for occupational therapists, orthoptists, speech and language therapists, neuro-optometrists and stroke rehabilitation teams.

## Key facts

- Two apps: Stroke Sight (visual field / reading after stroke) and ReWrite (handwriting / hand dexterity).
- Price: £29.99 one-time purchase per app. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads.
- Works entirely offline after the initial download; collects no user data.
- Available in 19 languages.
- Self-management and wellbeing tools, not medical devices; they do not diagnose, treat, or cure any condition and are meant to complement professional care.
- A free demo is available for each app.
- Contact: liam@ansteyapps.com · https://ansteyapps.com
